decision_scope: AUTHORIZE_ONLY_OWNER_SIDE_MATERIALIZATION_OF_THE_ALREADY_APPROVED_GRAMMAR_CORE_V1_CLASSIFICATIONS_AS_A_DEDICATED_REGISTRY_REFERENCING_EXISTING_HNK_LINGUAS_ENTRIES; DO_NOT_BIND_L03_OR_ANY_LESSON, UPGRADE_AUTHORITY, DUPLICATE_FORMS, AUTHOR_OPI, UNLOCK_QA, ALTER_STR003_STR005, CONSUME_PARENT_LEXEME_GATES, OR ACTIVATE_RUNTIME

materialization_decisions.proposal: Create a dedicated @hnk/linguas Grammar Core V1 registry rather than duplicating KE, AN, EN, KU or KUVAN in authored.mjs.
Reference existing owner entries AUTH-001 KUVAN, AUTH-016 AN, AUTH-017 EN, AUTH-018 KU and AUTH-019 KE with their existing CANDIDATE authority and existing lesson scopes unchanged.
Encode the approved semantic and boundary contracts for KE, AN, EN, KU and KUVAN in the dedicated registry without granting universal productivity.

Encode predication=CONSTRUCTION_SPECIFIC, negation=SCOPED_EXISTING_GOVERNED_USES_ONLY, and temporality=LEXICAL_SCOPED_FIRST as policy metadata; reference NE AUTH-004 and PA LEX-020 only as scoped supporting evidence.
Expose the dedicated registry through a new @hnk/linguas ./grammar-core-v1 package subpath with matching type declarations, after drift verification.
Add owner-side validation/tests for exact referenced IDs, authority preservation, scope preservation, no duplicate authored forms, and policy invariants.
Keep Cycle 1 and L03 bindings unchanged during owner materialization; Binah exact surface remains paused with 0/4 fields selected.
After successful owner materialization, open a separate Grammar Core V1 -> Cycle 1 binding strategy gate and stop.

governance_decisions.statement: Refetch codex-hnk main and owner files immediately before execution; material drift affecting component IDs, authorities, lesson scopes, or exports requires re-review.
Materialization must not upgrade CANDIDATE/WATCH authority, add FROZEN status, or alter existing authored candidate lesson arrays.
No L03 surface package, candidate, OPI/QA, STR003-STR005, or runtime action is authorized by this gate.
The independent DARUNO/NELARA parent-lexeme integration gate remains untouched and requires its own explicit approval.
HNK3000 remains parallel and receives no automatic Grammar Core or Cycle 1 binding.
A future SIGA in this conversation may approve only this owner-materialization gate; the same approval must stop after owner materialization and validation-state recording.
